name: aos-agent-skill-document
description: Turn source materials into professional Word and PDF deliverables through local rendering and page-by-page visual QA.

interface.shortDescription: End-to-end Word and PDF publishing with visual QA
interface.longDescription: A skills-only document publishing workflow for turning source materials into editable Word and fixed-layout PDF deliverables. It covers publication planning, DOCX authoring, PDF processing, metadata review, local rendering, and page-by-page visual verification. It is not an online Office suite or external conversion service and does not require an API key. The source repository includes a reproducible TAIZHOU brand-enterprise white-paper case.
defaultPrompt: Turn these source materials into an editable Word report and verified PDF.
Audit this PDF for metadata, page geometry, and rendered layout defects before modifying it.
Use the TAIZHOU case as a reference to build and visually verify a brand white paper.
